title: Distance spectral radius conditions for perfect $k$-matching, generalized factor-criticality (bicriticality) and $k$-$d$-criticality of graphs
summary: Let $G$ be a simple connected graph with vertex set $V(G)$ and edge set $E(G)$. A $k$-matching of a graph $G$ is a function $f:E(G)\rightarrow \{0,1,\ldots, k\}$ satisfying $\sum_{e \in E_G(v)} f(e) \leq k$ for every vertex $v \in V(G)$, where $E_G(v)$ is the set of edges incident with $v$ in $G$. A $k$-matching of a graph $G$ is perfect if $ \sum_{e \in E_G(v) } f(e) = k $ for any vertex $v \in V(G)$.
